subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the 14 updated action SHAs, particularly openai/codex-action v1.11, approved for use in OpenClaw's credentialed and publishing workflows after exact-source verification?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it replaces executable supply-chain components that handle secrets and release artifacts; repository policy requires direct Codex source inspection and explicit protected-security handling before merge.

options.title: Verify, rebase, and merge
options.body: Audit the official upstream commits, refresh onto current main, and merge only after the dependency and affected workflow gates pass on the exact head.

options.title: Split the Codex update
options.body: Land the routine action bumps separately while holding the Codex Action change for its required direct source and sandbox-contract audit.

options.title: Close and regenerate
options.body: If Dependabot cannot produce a current clean head, close this branch and let a fresh grouped update regenerate the pins from current main.

recommendation.title: Verify, rebase, and merge
recommendation.body: Audit the official upstream commits, refresh onto current main, and merge only after the dependency and affected workflow gates pass on the exact head.
